title: asyneuma canescens subsp. salicifolium
intro: Asyneuma canescens subsp. salicifolium, commonly known as  alpine asyneuma or alpine asyneuma, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the bellflower family. It is a perennial herb used in traditional medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of alpine asyneuma include soothing skin irritations, reducing inflammation, and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of alpine asyneuma include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
